name: The Artists Gallery (TAG)
about_text: The Artists Gallery (TAG) is an artist-founded, not-for-profit arts cooperative now based in the Miracle Mile district of Los Angeles. Established in Santa Monica in 1993, TAG is run and staffed by its member artists rather than commercial dealers. Its program centers on Southern Californian, national, and international artists working across media, with monthly solo and group exhibitions plus recurring juried shows such as Made in the USA, the L.A. Open, and the Shelley Lazarus Excellence in Watercolor Exhibition. The gallery also hosts artist talks, studio nights, and community events, reflecting its mission to support free exploration of media, technique, and content among its member artists.

notes: Site does not name individual founders, only describes TAG as 'artist-founded and operated.' Board of Directors, Co-Presidents, Leadership Circle, and Senior Gallerists are listed on the About page but roles are not clearly distinguished as 'directors' in a traditional sense; all are included under directors here. Several roster entries (e.g., BLKLit, California Art League, The Collymore Oil Painters Atelier, SCWCA, SFVACC) are groups/collectives listed on the TAG Artists page rather than individual artists.

triage.site_notes: The site is organised around a roster of member artists (/artists, /vtag-artists) each with individual bio pages, an events/news blog for press and openings, and yearly exhibition-schedule pages (2022–2025) that serve as an archive; no dedicated fairs page was found and most individual exhibition/show pages are already summarized in the yearly schedules.
